name: Babak Falsafi
one_sentence_summary: Babak Falsafi leads PARSA at EPFL, researching post-Moore server architecture, datacenter systems, GPU microarchitecture, and AI hardware efficiency — with recent work on mixed-precision quantization for LLM inference, silicon-efficient chiplets, and full-system simulation.
matrix_summary: PARSA's Shilin Lin and Yifan Li have both completed their PhDs in 2026, and Lin's MICRO 2026 paper on scalable time-based full-system simulation sampling is now on record. No major new research directions since the last update.
